title: Determinants of centromeric nucleosome conformation.
authors: Paintsil, Emeleeta A; Lee, Joshua; Meidl Zahorodny, Sarah S; Wereszczynski, Jeff; Morrison, Emma A
one_liner_zh: 该文通过粗粒化分子动力学模拟和MNase实验，系统研究CENP-A无序N端区域对着丝粒核小体DNA构象的协同调控，虽对象为核小体而非典型IDP-PPI，但无序区域介导的构象灵活性机制建模对本课题有可迁移启发。
abstract: Centromeric chromatin is defined by the presence of the histone H3 variant CENP-A, which forms a specialized nucleosome required for kinetochore assembly. Compared to canonical H3 nucleosomes, CENP-A nucleosomes exhibit an open DNA conformation that leaves an additional 13 base pairs of DNA accessible at the entry and exit sites. While the CENP-A alphaN-helix has previously been implicated in promoting this enhanced DNA breathing, the contributions of the intrinsically disordered N-terminal tail and adjacent latch regions of CENP-A to nucleosome conformation remain unknown. The intrinsically disordered N-terminal regions of histone H3 are known to facilitate interactions with DNA to stabilize overall nucleosome conformation. Here, we utilized a combination of MNase digestion assays and coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations of nucleosomes containing targeted swaps of the H3 and CENP-A tail, latch, and alphaN-helix regions to systematically test the contribution of each N-terminal histone region to nucleosomal DNA conformation. Substitution of individual H3 N-terminal regions with those of CENP-A opened the DNA at the entry/exit sites and increased DNA accessibility. While any single CENP-A N-terminal region was sufficient to open the canonical nucleosomal DNA conformation, replacement of any single CENP-A N-terminal region with its H3 counterpart was insufficient to restore the closed DNA conformation characteristic of canonical H3 nucleosomes. Instead, progressive incorporation of multiple H3-derived regions produced increasingly closed DNA conformations, demonstrating that the H3 tail, latch, and alphaN-helices act cooperatively to stabilize wrapped nucleosomal DNA. Taken together, these findings demonstrate that the more restricted DNA breathing of canonical nucleosomes arises from coordinated contributions across multiple N-terminal regions and suggest that the multi-region redundancy in the conformational flexibility of the centromeric nucleosome could emphasize the importance of retaining flexibility in the centromeric nucleosome, even upon post-translational modification and binding to structural proteins.
abstract_zh: 着丝粒染色质以组蛋白H3变体CENP-A的存在为特征，该变体形成着丝粒组装所需的特化核小体。与经典H3核小体相比，CENP-A核小体表现出开放的DNA构象，在入口和出口位点额外暴露13个碱基对的DNA。尽管先前已提示CENP-A的alphaN-螺旋参与促进这种增强的DNA呼吸，但CENP-A的内在无序N端尾部及相邻闩锁区域对核小体构象的贡献仍未知。已知组蛋白H3的内在无序N端区域促进与DNA的相互作用，以稳定整体核小体构象。在此，我们结合MNase消化实验和粗粒化分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，对含有H3和CENP-A尾部、闩锁及alphaN-螺旋区域定向交换的核小体进行研究，系统测试每个N端组蛋白区域对核小体DNA构象的贡献。将单个H3 N端区域替换为CENP-A对应区域，在入口/出口位点打开DNA并增加DNA可及性。虽然任何单个CENP-A N端区域足以打开经典核小体DNA构象，但将任何单个CENP-A N端区域替换为其H3对应区域不足以恢复经典H3核小体特有的闭合DNA构象。相反，逐步引入多个H3衍生区域产生越来越闭合的DNA构象，表明H3尾部、闩锁和alphaN-螺旋协同作用以稳定包裹的核小体DNA。综合来看，这些发现表明经典核小体更受限的DNA呼吸源于多个N端区域的协调贡献，并提示着丝粒核小体构象灵活性中的多区域冗余可能强调保留着丝粒核小体灵活性的重要性，即使在翻译后修饰和与结构蛋白结合后也是如此。
